web_refactor_hint.intent: Ferrite web page-crate shape (dev -> main lane). Page crates under crates/web/admin-page-* and crates/web/tavern-page-* must keep: (1) page orchestration in src/tab-page/<tab>.rs, (2) page-unique components in src/components/, (3) shared UI primitives and style constants in crates/web/ui-components, (4) shared style constants referenced via ui::styles / ui::CARD_SHELL_CLASS etc. Flag diffs that introduce or leave flat src/tab-page-* directories, long repeated Tailwind class strings that should be shared constants, page-local components that are duplicated across more than one page crate, or missing shared UI primitives that two or more pages need.

refactor_hint.instructions: Classify the refactor need visible in this web diff. Pick the single most specific bucket; use 'mixed' when two or more buckets apply and 'no_action' when the diff already follows the page-crate shape.

criteria.page_shape: The diff creates or keeps a flat src/tab-page-* directory instead of src/tab-page/<tab>.rs plus src/components/.
criteria.style_unification: The diff adds or leaves a long repeated Tailwind class string that should be a shared ui::styles constant or ui component.
criteria.shared_component: The diff adds a component inside a page crate that is already used by, or identical to, a component in another page crate or in ui-components.
criteria.mixed: At least two of the other buckets apply to the same diff.
criteria.no_action: The diff already uses src/tab-page/ + src/components/ and shared ui primitives/constants; no refactor hint is needed.

refactor_severity.instructions: How much should this diff be scheduled for refactor work in the web-dev lane?
criteria: 0: The diff is already in the target page-crate shape and uses shared primitives; no action.
1: Minor advisory; one repeated class or one flat directory that can be fixed in a later pass.
2: The diff adds a new flat page-crate shape or duplicates a component that should be moved to ui-components now.
3: The diff leaves multiple pages with duplicated styles/components and will block the web-dev -> main release if not refactored.
